// Overlay-only read fixture in the owning Coordinator module. No scheduler,
// model, provider or underwriting HTTP client runs.
package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	customercontext "github.com/slabarcaf/flowcard-treasury/services/go-coordinator/internal/context"
	"github.com/slabarcaf/flowcard-treasury/services/go-coordinator/internal/postgres"
	"github.com/slabarcaf/flowcard-treasury/services/go-coordinator/internal/underwriting"
)

func TestOwnedBrowserFinancialReads(t *testing.T) {
	lifetime := 100 * time.Second
	if value := os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_LIFETIME"); value != "" {
		parsed, err := time.ParseDuration(value)
		if err != nil || parsed < time.Second || parsed > 15*time.Minute {
			t.Fatal("invalid owned read lifetime")
		}
		lifetime = parsed
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), lifetime)
	defer cancel()
	admin, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_ADMIN_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator admin unavailable")
	}
	defer admin.Close()
	var name, marker, before, after string
	if err := admin.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database(),shobj_description(oid,'pg_database') FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()`).Scan(&name, &marker); err != nil || name != os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_DATABASE") || marker != os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_MARKER") {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator target mismatch")
	}
	if err := admin.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT md5(row_to_json(r)::text) FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname='coordinator_runtime' AND NOT rolcanlogin`).Scan(&before); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("existing coordinator role required")
	}
	if err := postgres.RunMigrations(ctx, admin); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator migrations failed")
	}
	if err := admin.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT md5(row_to_json(r)::text) FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname='coordinator_runtime'`).Scan(&after); err != nil || after != before {
		t.Fatal("shared coordinator role changed")
	}
	role := os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_ROLE")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(role, "browser_rt_") {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator runtime role mismatch")
	}
	if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, "GRANT coordinator_runtime TO "+pgx.Identifier{role}.Sanitize()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator runtime grant failed")
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO coordinator.source_bindings(id,mode,fingerprint,endpoint_identity) VALUES('owned-financial-binding','DEMO',$1,'owned read fixture')`, strings.Repeat("0", 64)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator binding seed failed")
	}
	if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO coordinator.discovery_progress(binding_id) VALUES('owned-financial-binding')`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator progress seed failed")
	}
	caseID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO coordinator.cases(id,binding_id,kind,detection_id,customer_id,account_ref,raw_account_id,status,next_stage) VALUES($1,'owned-financial-binding','SHORTFALL','owned-shortfall','owned-customer','customer:owned-customer','private-owned-account','COMPLETED','COMPLETE')`, caseID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned saved case seed failed")
	}
	principal, fee, total := int64(700000), int64(19000), int64(719000)
	evaluation := underwriting.Evaluation{ID: "owned-evaluation", ShortfallID: "owned-shortfall", CustomerID: "owned-customer", AccountID: "private-owned-account", TransactionID: "private-owned-transaction", SourceMode: "DEMO", EvaluatedAt: now, CreatedAt: now, PolicyID: "owned-read-policy", PolicyHash: strings.Repeat("0", 64), Status: "REVIEW_REQUIRED", FundingAuthorized: false, RequiresRecheck: true, PrincipalCents: &principal, EstimatedFeeCents: &fee, TotalDueCents: &total, TermDays: 30, Rules: []underwriting.Rule{}, ReasonCodes: []string{}}
	for i := 1; i <= 10; i++ {
		rule := fmt.Sprintf("READ_RULE_%02d", i)
		evaluation.Rules = append(evaluation.Rules, underwriting.Rule{ID: rule, Status: "UNKNOWN", ReasonCode: rule + "_UNKNOWN", Actual: json.RawMessage(`{}`), Threshold: json.RawMessage(`{}`), SourceRefs: []customercontext.SourceRef{}})
		evaluation.ReasonCodes = append(evaluation.ReasonCodes, rule+"_UNKNOWN")
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(evaluation)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("saved evaluation fixture encoding failed")
	}
	request := []byte(`{"shortfall_id":"owned-shortfall","term_days":30}`)
	hash := sha256.Sum256(request)
	if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO coordinator.assessments(case_id,revision,idempotency_key,request_body,request_hash,saved_assessment_id,response_body,saved_at,source_transaction_id,source_card_id) VALUES($1,1,'owned-read-evaluation',$2,$3,'owned-evaluation',$4,now(),'private-owned-transaction','private-owned-card')`, caseID, request, hash[:], raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned saved evaluation seed failed")
	}
	repo, err := postgres.Connect(ctx, os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_RUNTIME_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator runtime unavailable")
	}
	defer repo.Close()
	if err := repo.Ready(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator runtime not ready")
	}
	handler, err := NewCaseHandler(repo, "owned-financial-binding", "DEMO", os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_SECRET"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned coordinator reader unavailable")
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(handler)
	defer server.Close()
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_ADDRESS_FILE"), []byte(server.URL), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("coordinator address file failed")
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("coordinator read harness deadline exceeded")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(os.Getenv("OWNED_READ_CONTROL_FILE")); os.IsNotExist(err) {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}
